notes.title: Recontact London production documentary on BBC Turkey.
notes.content:
Recontact London production documentary on BBC Turkish.

Simay Dinç, the producer of the game, told the BBC cameras about the production process of Recontact London, which was directed and designed by Eray Dinç. The BBC Turkey team followed the preparation of our team's London themed detective game in Istanbul and London.

Enjoy watching.
